scope: The connected main hotel at the Omni Homestead Resort in Hot Springs, Virginia as documented in 2021 and 2022, including its 1902 principal block, columned entrance, brick wings and 1929 clock tower. Detached resort facilities are outside its scope.

originalReview.notes: The winter original shows the 1929 brick clock tower, its green roof and white lantern, the three-storey principal block, and the white portico and verandas.
The September 2021 Old Course view shows the long brick hotel wings and the tower above the valley.

quallaSearch.notes: Both exact Qualla originals match their only Commons releases. The Ninjaneer photographed and uploaded both as their own work and placed them under CC0. Interior, ski and pool imagery was outside the model scope.
